about.title: About Sai Teja
about.content: I'm Sai Teja — a backend-focused engineer with 3+ years building distributed systems and enterprise-grade platforms. I care about writing clean, efficient code and understanding the system end-to-end, not just the layer I own. Currently at Dhan AI, I've shipped across customer portals, internal operations tooling, and a large-scale multi-tenant CXP platform. I'm drawn to hard problems — event-driven architectures, microservice coordination, and systems that need to be resilient at scale. Outside of work, I'm deep into Generative AI and AI Agents, tracking what's happening in open source, and solving problems on LeetCode. I also post about tech on Instagram — because explaining something well is how I know I actually get it.

experience.description: Building distributed backend systems serving enterprise and consumer clients across customer portals, internal operations tooling, and a large-scale multi-tenant CXP platform. Working with Node.js, TypeScript, Kafka, GraphQL, PostgreSQL, MongoDB, Redis, AWS.
highlights: Shipped 15+ microservices across the CXP platform
Architected event-driven systems using Apache Kafka
Integrated Salesforce, Dynamics 365, and Firebase RBAC

experience.description: Python scripting and cybersecurity tooling. Applied automation to security workflows and vulnerability assessments.
Intensive Data Structures & Algorithms training. Built strong foundations in problem-solving and algorithmic thinking that underpin every system I design today.
Hands-on experience in threat analysis, security tooling, and foundational cybersecurity certification.

projects.title: Customer Self-Service Portal
projects.description: A customer-facing platform enabling users to view and manage active services in real time. Architected as a middleware microservice layer, bridging the frontend with multiple external service providers — handling auth, session management, and data orchestration.
projects.impact: Real-time service management for enterprise telecom customers

projects.title: Agent Operations Platform
projects.description: Internal tooling for support agents to manage services and handle trouble tickets end-to-end. Built a proactive network diagnostics engine that detects and resolves infrastructure issues before customers are impacted — reducing dispatches and cutting resolution costs.
projects.impact: Reduced support dispatches and infrastructure resolution costs

projects.title: Enterprise CXP Platform
projects.description: Modernized a large-scale customer experience platform with 15+ microservices powering onboarding, billing, payments, and order lifecycle. Delivered 30% improvement in API response times. Integrated Salesforce, Dynamics 365, and Firebase RBAC.
projects.impact: 30% improvement in API response times; 15+ microservices shipped

contact.availability: Open for collaboration, interesting backend problems, and conversations about distributed systems or AI agents. Whether it's a new role, a side project, or just a good engineering discussion — my inbox is always open.
